name: Primitive Survival
description: Fundamental knowledge of stone shaping and rough timber crafting.

name: Carpentry & Joinery
description: Process raw logs into flat structural planks, crafting tables and storage chests.

name: Stone Masonry
description: Heft rough stone blocks into defensive fortifications and thermal fire kilns.

name: Pyrology & Kiln Charcoal
description: Utilize dense anthracite coal to reach the extreme temperatures needed for metallurgy.

name: Hunting Archery
description: Fashion curved wooden hunting bows and sharp stone-tipped arrows for long-range defense.

name: Iron Ore Smelting
description: Melt raw iron ore in stone furnaces to produce pure iron ingots.

name: Iron Blade Forging
description: Hammer glowing iron ingots into sharp swords and spike perimeter traps.

name: Chainmail Weaving
description: Link hundreds of iron rings into flexible, impenetrable chainmail coifs and hauberks.

name: Mechanical Crossbows
description: Assemble steel-tension composite crossbows with immense penetrating force.

name: Herbalism & Field Medicine
description: Distill curative compounds from wild meadow herbs to treat severe bleeding and disease.
